text: {"label": "Theory and Methods of Equivalence Relations","definition": "Conceptual, methodological, and basic experimental work on derived equivalence relations, including their properties such as reflexivity and transitivity, contextual control, transfer of meaning, relations of difference or opposition, and their theoretical status.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Examines the nature and properties of equivalence relations themselves, rather than variables affecting equivalence class formation, relational frame theory as a broad account, or applied and verbal relational responding."}
